displayName.description: Trimmed/NFC normalized; 1–5 Unicode grapheme clusters, not UTF-16 characters; no controls.

connected.description: True for a live human connection or a permanent BOT. A HUMAN under BOT_TAKEOVER remains false.

controlMode.description: HUMAN: original human control; RECONNECTING: disconnected human within grace; BOT_TAKEOVER: temporary server control while original human identity remains; BOT: permanent computer seat. connected remains false for a disconnected HUMAN under takeover.

GameSnapshot.description: Personalized game projection, not a request. Detailed fields, phases and redaction are normative in CONTRACT.md (Exact snapshot types). This deliberately extensible summary is not a complete runtime validation schema.

lastRedealReason.description: Latest reason within current dealIndex, reset for next scored deal. Count includes both hand redeals and all-Pass redeals; no triggering player or points.

MatchArchive.description: See CONTRACT.md MatchArchive. Completed settled cards may be visible; unfinished cards remain hidden. Extensible response summary.

allHumansReconnectDeadline.description: Display-only epoch milliseconds for the 10-second all-human-offline grace. Server monotonic clock is authoritative. Null when not applicable.

MatchResult.description: Legacy forfeit values remain compatible. Current disconnect/leave no-human termination yields NO_CONTEST, null winner and empty failedTeamIds.

RedealDecision.description: Personalized only: own HCP/eligibility/choice, never another seat. Outside REDEAL_DECISION points and choice are null and flags false. No actor list or aggregate private choices.

signedIn.description: Google linked to this guest session, not an assertion about Google website sign-in.
